title: Group S-1.
officialText:
An automatic sprinkler system shall be provided throughout all buildings containing a Group S-1 occupancy where any one of the following conditions exists:
1. A Group S-1 fire area exceeds 12,000 square feet (1115 m2);
2. The building is greater than 1,000 square feet (92.9 m2) in area and the main use or dominant occupancy is Group S-1; or
3. A Group S-1 fire area is located more than three stories above grade plane.
4. The combined area of all Group S-1 fire areas on all floors, including any mezzanines, exceeds 24,000 square feet (2230 m2).
